version: LOCK 6 V1 (8 Nov 2026) - talking to people
builds_on: LOCK 1-5. Lines depend on River Market trust (tiers) and on what this person saw or heard. Placeholders: {name}.

people.name: Salma

tier.wary: Salma keeps kneading and barely looks up.
tier.friendly: Salma wipes flour from her hands and smiles.
tier.warm: Salma tears off a piece of warm bread and holds it out to you.

facts.grab_lie: “You looked me in the eye once and lied. I remember.”
facts.grab_truth: “You told me the truth about the bread. Not everyone would.”
facts.grab_pay: “Faris carries my wood now. I know who paid for that loaf.”

people.tip: “Everyone passes my oven. If someone in this street is in trouble, I hear it first.”

people.name: Rashid

tier.wary: Rashid watches your hands while you stand at his stall.
tier.friendly: Rashid nods and holds up a pinch of cumin for you to smell.
tier.warm: Rashid calls you over before you even reach his stall.

facts.returned: “The one who gave back my coins! Come, smell this saffron.”
facts.kept: “Count your change, foreigner. I count mine.”

people.tip: “Prices go up when the boats are late. Buy before the river rises.”

people.name: Layla

tier.wary: Layla keeps her eyes on her loom.
tier.friendly: Layla looks up and studies the cloth you are wearing.
tier.warm: Layla stops her loom to talk to you.

facts.own_cloth: “My cloth suits you. Wear it well.”
facts.traveller: “Still in your foreign clothes? People will keep calling you the foreigner.”

people.tip: “Good cloth lasts years. Cheap cloth lasts a season. People are the same.”

people.name: Jamal

tier.wary: Jamal shouts orders at the boatmen and ignores you.
tier.friendly: Jamal lifts a hand to you between orders.
tier.warm: Jamal grins and claps you on the shoulder.

facts.fed: “The boy Faris says you fed him. Good.”
facts.boat: “Good hands on the ropes. Come back tomorrow.”

people.tip: “A boat comes in every morning. There is always work for those who come early.”

people.name: Old Musa

tier.wary: Old Musa squints at you over his scales.
tier.friendly: Old Musa makes room for you beside the scales.
tier.warm: Old Musa tells you a story about the market when he was young.

facts.learned: “You read a scale well now. Nobody will cheat you twice.”
facts.not_learned: “Come, I will show you how the scales tell the truth.”

people.tip: “A scale does not lie. Only the hand on it does.”
